chunks: Muhammad ibn 'Ali ibn Mahbub, from al-'Abbas, from Safwan, from al-Qasim ibn Muhammad, from Sulayman Mawla Tirbal, from 'Ubayd ibn Zurarah, who said:
I heard Aba 'Abdillah عليه السلام saying: The whole earth is a masjid, except a well of excrement, or a graveyard, or a bathhouse.

key_terms.الْأَرْضُ: the earth; the generality of places on the ground suitable for prayer
key_terms.بِئْرَ غَائِطٍ: a pit or well used for excrement; an impure place excluded from prayer
key_terms.حَمَّامًا: a bathhouse; a location excluded from prayer in this narration
key_terms.مَسْجِدٌ: a place of sajdah and prayer
key_terms.مَقْبَرَةً: a graveyard; a location excluded from prayer in this narration

ai.seo_question: Which places are excluded from the general rule that the whole earth is a masjid for prayer?
ai.summary: This hadith states a legal ruling concerning places in which salat may be performed. It establishes the general permissibility of the earth as a place of prayer while excluding specific impure or unsuitable locations such as a well of excrement, a graveyard, and a bathhouse.
